headline: Jordan sees how goals, structured or freestyle practice, voice timing, video, and progress records form one repeatable training loop.
overview: A live product-level walk for Handstand Quest · Web, framed around Jordan Lee's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
targetAudience: Can kick up to a wall but practices inconsistently. Jordan needs a short repeatable session and visible progress, not a library that assumes they already know how to program handstand training.

steps.title: The promise is consistency and measurement
steps.description: Jordan is told what improves: practice frequency and measurable hold time, not an abstract fitness score.

steps.title: Goals become scheduled habits
steps.description: The product connects an outcome to recurring exercises instead of leaving Jordan with a one-off workout.
steps.screenshotAlt: Handstand Quest goals and habit scheduling

steps.title: Voice keeps hands off the screen
steps.description: Start and stop voice commands make timing compatible with being upside down—the interaction is designed around the physical task.

steps.title: Structure and freestyle coexist
steps.description: Jordan can follow a program while learning, then choose exercises directly when energy or time changes.
steps.screenshotAlt: Handstand Quest structured and freestyle workout choices

steps.title: The loop closes on evidence
steps.description: Records, per-exercise stats, custom exercises, workouts, and hands-free video make improvement reviewable rather than anecdotal.
steps.screenshotAlt: Handstand Quest progress, custom exercise, and video features
